_doc: Named exceptions for frontface_verbatims_clean (tools/invariants.py). Each entry is a FACTUAL CLAIM about the world and must carry a reason a reviewer can check. An entry with no reason is itself RED (memory: gate-exceptions-are-world-claims). EMPTY IS THE GOAL: an exception is a defect we chose to live with, so the list shrinking is progress and it growing needs review.

_history.why: Added the same day the gate landed, for a real table-column artefact: the OCR read ACROSS columns on Let's Play Doctor p85, splicing 'Pharma-' (from 'Pharmacologic', broken inside its own column) onto 'Need' from the neighbouring 'True Supplement Need' column. RETIRED because the defect was FIXED, not waived — the header was normalized column-wise to 'Nutrient RDA True Supplement Need 30-Day Pharmacologic Daily Dose' against the page image, with every dose figure re-read by eye (BIOTIN: RDA 200 mcg / True Supplement Need 200 mcg / 30-Day Pharmacologic Daily Dose 500 to 3,000 mcg). Kept here so the exception's whole life is on the record rather than vanishing.
